tess (devex): Heads-up: release pipeline published @redwood/sdk-python v2.3.0 but the post-release check reported a typegen diff on the tag.
omar: which file changed?
tess (devex): paste from the job: ```
$ yarn workspace @redwood/sdk-python typegen:check
Error: Generated schema out of date: redwood_sdk/client/openapi_models.py
- old: class Foo(BaseModel):
    bar: Optional[str] = None
+ new: class Foo(BaseModel):
    bar: str
Run yarn typegen:regen and commit.
```
release-bot: Release created: @redwood/sdk-python v2.3.0 (tag v2.3.0)
sam (sdk): Oh, I added a required flag in the OpenAPI PR earlier; changelog generator picked it up so the changelog mentioned "types tightened". Looks like the tag was created before someone ran typegen.
omar: So we have ordering and runner-tool drift. The runners had typegen v3.0.0 but our local dev used v2.9.1 where preserve-optional was default true.
typegen-bot: Runner detected CLI version 3.0.0. Note: 3.0.0 flips preserve-optional default.
ci-bot: [CI] job #5203: post-publish/typegen-check failed.
tess (devex): Immediate plan: push a regen commit to main and cut v2.3.1 as a patch referencing the original changelog. Longer: change .github/workflows/release.yml to run typegen:check BEFORE tagging and pin the typegen CLI in the action image.
sam (sdk): Agree. Also add a local dev note: run `yarn typegen:regen` and commit before opening the changelog PR.
omar: We should also add a short check in the release action that after running typegen it runs `git status --porcelain` and prints diffs if non-empty, then exit 1. That way tagging is blocked.
docs-bot: Filed doc PR: docs/releasing.md update with explicit order: 1) openapi change 2) typegen:regen & commit 3) changelog 4) tag and publish.
tess (devex): I'll open the regen PR now and a follow-up PR to pin typegen and gate tagging. After regen PR merges we'll publish v2.3.1.
ci-bot: [CI] PR #1105 (regen): typecheck OK, tests OK, typegen-check failed (expected diff until regen commit merged).
omar: CI failing on regen PR is expected and good. It forces explicit commit.
sam (sdk): Also let's add a linter rule to warn if generated files are modified in a PR without a commit message containing "chore(gen): regen". We can gradually enforce it.
tess (devex): Thanks all. I'll merge when green and coordinate the patch publish. :thumbsup:
-- end of thread --
